trait.name: Spirit and Trinity
trait.text: You start with a Hawk, a Bear and a Thunderbird totem; each helps your first spell of its element each turn, and cards command them to act. The first time each turn you cast a Flame, a Frost and a Storm spell, Trinity gives you 1 Spirit. Spirit never goes down: each point adds 1 to your totems' commands, and every 2 add 1 to their help.

hawk.name: Hawk
hawk.text: Your first Flame spell each turn: +3 to every damage and Barrier number on it. Command: 6 damage to a random enemy.

bear.name: Bear
bear.text: Your first Frost spell each turn: +3 to every damage and Barrier number on it. Command: gain 5 Barrier.

thunderbird.name: Thunderbird
thunderbird.text: Your first Storm spell each turn: +2 to every damage and Barrier number on it (each hit). Command: 3 damage to every enemy.

elder.name: Elder Tree
elder.text: Planting it gives 2 Spirit. Your first elemental spell each turn: +2 to every damage and Barrier number on it. Command: gain 1 Spirit and draw a card.

owl.name: Moon Owl
owl.text: Whenever Trinity triggers, gain 1 Mana. Command: your next elemental spell costs 0.
